facts.project_name: ALCON SAP ECC 6.0 Ehp6 to SAP S/4HANA 2025 On-Premise Upgrade
facts.duration: 21 months (derived from 20 months of Technical Conversion + 1 month of Hypercare)

facts.scope_summary: Technical conversion of Alcon's SAP ECC 6.0 EHP6 landscape to SAP S/4HANA 2025 On-Premise using a no-change principle, including Oracle/AIX to HANA 2.0 on Red Hat Linux migration, downtime-optimized conversion, testing/qualification, analytics remediation, cutover, hypercare, and transition to AMS. The program covers 53 countries, 90 legal entities, and 18 manufacturing plants with a target of no more than 48 hours production downtime.
in_scope: Conversion from SAP ECC 6.0 Ehp6 to SAP S/4HANA 2025 On-Premise Upgrade
Oracle 19c on AIX to HANA 2.0 on Red Hat Linux 9.6 platform
Mandatory SAP Simplification items (133 No) remediation through No-Change Principle
SUM/DMO Downtime Optimized Conversion (DoC) with CustOnTemp
Update of security framework, add-ons & bolt-on
SAP BW, Datasphere, and SAC remediation
out_of_scope: Changes beyond mandatory simplifications / no-change principle
commercials: Business downtime target: ≤48 hours / <48 hours during production cutover
Estimated 30% optimization in business downtime with structured iteration
Source DB – Dev 3.10TB, QAS 37.86TB; Target DB – Dev 1.51TB, QAS 18.73TB
Source DB Size for PRD Conversion – 41.50TB; Target DB – 20.20TB
assumptions: No-Change Principle applies to the conversion
Mandatory simplification items only; no elective changes
As on March 2026 counts assumed for custom code/object inventory
Month zero will be used for Pre planning activities
Bristlecone OCM deliverable frequency/intensity depends on the start date of the Bristlecone OCM resource
Alcon-led source prep with partner support for system builds/refreshes
BCP/DR plan can be shared under NDA upon request
